preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1]) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[0:1]) and 1 <= int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[2]) <= min(int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0]) * int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[1]), 7)
preconditions.description: Input must contain valid integers n, m, k where 1 ≤ n, m ≤ 100, n·m ≤ 200, and 1 ≤ k ≤ min(n·m, 7).

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == n + k + 1 and all(len(line.split()) == m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1]) and all(1 <= int(aij) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1] for aij in line.split())
preconditions.description: Input must contain exactly n lines of m integers (1 ≤ aij ≤ 1000) followed by k lines of coordinates (x, y) where 1 ≤ x ≤ n and 1 ≤ y ≤ m.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[n+1:]) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= m for line in stdin.splitlines()[n+1:])
preconditions.description: Important squares coordinates must be within the garden bounds (1 ≤ x ≤ n, 1 ≤ y ≤ m).

preconditions.expression: len({(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[n+1:]}) == k
preconditions.description: All k important squares must have unique coordinates.

postconditions.expression: stdout.splitlines()[0].isdigit() and int(stdout.splitlines()[0]) >= sum(aij for (i, line) in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1], 1) for (j, aij) in enumerate(line.split(), 1) if (i, j) in important_squares)
postconditions.description: The first line of stdout must be a non-negative integer representing the minimum total number of dead plants, which is at least the sum of flowers in all important squares (since they must be covered).

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.splitlines()) == n and all(len(line) == m for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]) and all(c in '.X' for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] for c in line)
postconditions.description: The next n lines of stdout must form an n × m grid where each cell is either '.' (not covered) or 'X' (covered with concrete).

postconditions.expression: all((i, j) in important_squares for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, m+1) if stdout.splitlines()[i].split()[j-1] == 'X')
postconditions.description: All important squares must be covered with concrete ('X').
The concrete-covered squares ('X') must form a connected region that includes all important squares, where connectivity is defined by adjacent squares (sharing a side).

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.splitlines()[0]) == sum(int(aij) for (i, line) in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1], 1) for (j, aij) in enumerate(line.split(), 1) if stdout.splitlines()[i][j-1] == 'X')
postconditions.description: The first line of stdout must equal the total number of flowers in all concrete-covered squares ('X').

invariants.expression: important_squares := {(int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdin.splitlines()[n+1:]}
invariants.description: important_squares is the set of all k important square coordinates (1-based).
is_connected checks if all concrete-covered squares ('X') form a single connected region that includes all important squares.
